newsitem.title: USA: ADM forms 4-member chief executive office.
newsitem.headline: ADM forms 4-member chief executive office.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co. said Thursday it made changes in top management, including the formation of a four-member office of the chief executive.

ADM said the executives include Chairman Dwayne Andreas, President James Randall, Charles Bayless, president of its processing division, and G. Allen Andreas, who is counsel to the executive committee of the board of directors.
The agribusiness giant also said the board chose Gaylord Coan as vice chairman of the board. Coan is chief executive officer of Gold Kist Inc. and an ADM board member.
Earlier this month, ADM said Michael Andreas, vice chairman and son of the company chairman, had taken a temporary leave.

ADM, which has agreed to pay $100 million in fines to settle price-fixing charges in the United States, has said indictments were being considered against Michael Andreas and Terrance Wilson, a group vice president in charge of corn refining, who has retired for medical reasons.
ADM said Larry Cunningham, president of ADM's protein specialities division, was named to the additional post of president of its corn processing division and a group vice president.
